verdict.rationale: Orrick publishes AI-related products of its own: a named Generative AI Policy Builder tool in Tech Studio, Tech Studio resources for integrating AI, and Orrick Labs, which builds legal technology solutions for clients. These are AI-practice offerings for clients' own governance, though, and nothing in the pack describes how Orrick itself uses AI in delivering client service. Missing for 10: a published firm AI-use policy or disclosure, named AI tools used in client matters, any statement that Orrick Labs or Orrick Connect uses AI, and independent corroboration.
